How to work this

The app, filed by job — not by where a screen sits in the nav. 14 categories, 83 screens, and 16 overlaps: places where several features do the same job. Each overlap gets its own call — become one, keep apart, or cut the lot — and each screen gets keep / rework / cut. Nothing is sent anywhere; it saves in this browser, and Export my verdict gives you text to paste back to me.

J / K move · 1 keep · 2 rework · 3 cut · 0 clear · N note. Skipping is fine — not judged brings you back.
